sloka: निर्जितास् ते महाबाहो नागा गत्वा रसा तलम् ।वासुकिस् तक्षकः शन्खो जटी च वशम् आहृताः ॥६-७-९॥।।
transliteration: nirjitās te mahābāho nāgā gatvā rasā talam ।vāsukis takṣakaḥ śankho jaṭī ca vaśam āhṛtāḥ ॥6-7-9॥।।

translations.english: "Maya, the ruler of Danavas has given his daughter (Mandodari) to you as a wife out of fear of you, O leader of Rakshasas"
